description: Scripting SELECT ... INTO variables (single/multiple vars, LIMIT/OFFSET/FETCH FIRST/QUALIFY, zero-rows-assigns-NULL, RESULT_SCAN read, more-than-one-row error) plus := assignment from UDF calls. Converted 1:1 from features/SelectIntoTest and UdfAssignTest (both now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION f() RETURNS OBJECT AS '{}'
DECLARE o OBJECT DEFAULT NULL; BEGIN o := f(); RETURN o; END
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION f() RETURNS OBJECT AS '{}'
DECLARE o OBJECT DEFAULT NULL; BEGIN o := (f()); RETURN o; END
